name: One Lie
source:
You and Julie (you will have a choice to change their names) have been best friends since a young age. You are best friends and have been through a lot together. Julie is the only person in this world whom you trust implicitly. And to you, loyalty and trust are the most important parts of life. The two of you are getting ready to enter college.
However, Julie makes a mistake. In the heat of the moment, she lies to your girlfriend about the closeness of your friendship. It breaks your heart and your trust in her. You feel betrayed. Not only is she the closest person to you she lies about you, thus using you to hurt someone. You decide that it would be best to go to another college and do so on your own, away from Julie.

Did you overreact? You don't feel that way. You have been betrayed and used in the past, by those closest to you. Your parents. You cannot allow that in your life. So you leave.

Julie realizes what she has done and most importantly that she is in love with you. She chases after you. She is willing to do whatever it takes to, at least, be forgiven by you. And to tell you what she feels for you.
 
Will you forgive her? Do you have feelings for her? 
That is up to you to decide. But along the way you will encounter another young lady. How will that encounter affect your choice going forward?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2752750/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你和朱莉（你可以选择更改他们的名字）从小就是最好的朋友。你们是最好的朋友，一起经历了很多事情。朱莉是这个世界上唯一值得你绝对信任的人。对你来说，忠诚和信任是生活中最重要的部分。你们两个正准备进入大学。
然而，朱莉犯了一个错误。一时冲动，她向你的女朋友撒谎，说你们的友谊很亲密。这会伤害你的心和你对她的信任。你感觉被背叛了。她不仅是你最亲近的人，而且还对你撒谎，从而利用你来伤害某人。你决定最好自己去另一所大学，远离朱莉。

你反应过度了吗？你不这么觉得。你过去曾被最亲近的人背叛和利用。你的父母。你不能允许这种情况出现在你的生活中。所以你离开。

朱莉意识到她所做的一切，最重要的是她爱你。她追你。她愿意做任何事，至少能得到你的原谅。并告诉你她对你的感觉。
 
你会原谅她吗？你对她有感觉吗？
这由你决定。但一路上你会遇到另一位年轻女士。这次遭遇将如何影响你今后的选择？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2752750/]Steam[/url]]
